**Macrophage Biology: in vitro, in vivo, in silico.** A four-week block course for D-BIOL, ETH Zürich, Spring Semester 2027. Students build the textbook M1/M2 picture of macrophages with their own hands in a dish, then test it against real tissue macrophages in a published single-cell dataset. There are no prerequisites: the course starts from scratch. The [lectures](lectures.qmd) are optional further reading, with Tissue Repair I the closest in content.

::: {.callout-warning title="Under construction"}
The Blockrophage course runs for the first time in spring 2027 and is being built in the open. Interested students are welcome to apply and to give input through the [contact page](contact.qmd) or the [issues on GitHub](https://github.com/TizzuLab/blockrophage-course/issues). **Please do not use these protocols in the lab yet.** Values are unverified until this notice is gone.
:::

The repository is the course: the script, the schedule, every protocol, the background reading, the analysis code and a single-file companion students can hand to the language model of their choice.
